Definition: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)
BiblicalUsage: 1) encampment, camp; 1a) camp, place of encampment; 1b) camp of armed host, army camp; 1c) those who encamp, company, body of people
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
